items.title: Stocks lost $2 trillion. The market is wrong about AI
items.summary: The stock market lost $2 trillion in 40 minutes, and AI stocks took the worst of it, with Intel down more than half since October and AMD off 17% in a day. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why it happened and why he thinks the market is wrong, from GPU rental prices up 106% to the CPU boom and Anthropic's IPO valuation.

items.title: IREN stock soars, driven by massive gains in AI cloud sales

IREN Ltd. (IREN) stock is surging higher after reporting that its AI cloud sales have doubled since last quarter.

Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick and AInvest managing editor Adam Shapiro join Pras Subramanian to discuss IREN's post-earnings stock moves.

items.title: Oversold AI and chip stocks after the Nasdaq’s worst day since 2020
items.summary: Investing.com -- Thursday’s selloff hit technology stocks hard. The Nasdaq 100 fell 6.4%, its worst day since 2020. The S&P 500 lost 4.4%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped more than 12%. The trigger was Democratic midterm wins in key data-center states, which stoked fears of tougher AI regulation and a slower data-center buildout. Jefferies called it "reactionary, not a fundamental reset" (Nov 6, 2026).
